title: Token Halo Spectrogram: Exploratory UI for token-level cost timeline and export
creator: Amaya Park
description:
Problem: Product and platform teams need a compact way to inspect per-token cost behavior across conversations and model variants to diagnose regressions, optimize prompts, and create exportable artifacts for billing disputes. Existing token-cost views are table-heavy and lose temporal context. Goal: design an exploratory visualization — the 'Token Halo Spectrogram' — that surfaces per-token cost intensity across time, aligns tokens to messages and model variants, and supports CSV/JSON export and visual snapshot export for chargeback threads. This ticket covers concept exploration, prototype screens for Console Dashboards, export UX patterns, and a short design handoff doc for Engineering and PMs.

Scope: 1) Two dashboard widgets: a compact spectrogram mini and an expanded inspector with timeline scrub, message alignment, and model-variant toggle. 2) Export flows: token-level CSV (columns: timestamp, conversation_id, message_id, token_text, model, token_role, token_cost_usd, quantization_flag) and an annotated PNG/SVG snapshot for reports. 3) Pricing pattern layer: inline unit-cost legend with selectable price bands (list price vs negotiated price) and sample reconciliation scenarios. 4) Accessibility and perf constraints: must render ~10k tokens without blocking main thread (progressive rendering fallback).

Trade-offs considered: - Visual density vs readability: we prioritize a zoomed timeline mode over showing all tokens by default. Mini widget uses aggregated cost bands per message; inspector reveals per-token detail. - Export size: CSV export should truncate long token sequences by default with a checkbox to include full KV cache tokens to avoid massive files. - Color encoding: chose divergent sequential color ramp to represent cost intensity while keeping colorblind-safe palette and a mono-contrast option for print exports.

Deliverables: Figma prototype (mini + inspector), annotated handoff (CSV schema, API contract suggestions for ENG), acceptance criteria, and two rounds of stakeholder review notes.
acceptance_criteria: Mini spectrogram widget appears in Dashboard library and renders aggregated per-message cost bands within 200ms for 100 messages
Inspector screen shows per-token cost overlay aligned to message text, model-variant toggle, and timeline scrub
CSV export produces the agreed schema and includes metadata header with model version, pricing tier, and export timestamp
Snapshot export produces a labeled PNG and an optional SVG with selectable layers
Design tokens, color ramps, and accessibility notes included in handoff doc
Engineering has clear API contract and example backend query for token-level cost (ENG-3840)
